decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API remains close to the firm's core secure messaging and integration capabilities, and after another year on the market the firm's strong in-house R&D and operational learning make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

The email-to-SMS gateway builds directly on the firm's established email, messaging and cloud integration knowledge, so its absorptive capacity is high enough that early market feedback is more likely to be assimilated into improvements than to trigger discontinuation.

The SMS-to-email gateway is likewise highly related to the firm's existing communication platform and APIs, and given the firm's broad product base and internal R&D it is well positioned to learn quickly and keep the product rather than drop it.
